steps.now: 兔儿爷: a spirit that loves gold would go where the money is. Start at 三里屯 — line 10 to 团结湖.
steps.past: Went to 三里屯, the shiny new Beijing.

steps.now: Ask around 三里屯 — the parcel courier hears everything.
steps.past: The courier in 三里屯 had heard where the gold-lover goes.

steps.now: Ride line 10 south to 国贸 and go into the bank on the plaza.
steps.past: Rode to 国贸 and found something strange in the bank's hall.

steps.now: The 貔貅 loves golden things. The convenience store 便利店 next to the bank sells chocolate coins in gold paper.
steps.past: Bought chocolate coins in gold paper at the 便利店.

steps.now: Give the golden coins to the 貔貅 in the bank's hall.
steps.past: Gave the golden coins to the 貔貅 — it was very pleased.

steps.now: 兔儿爷 wants to see the Bird's Nest: line 8 north to 奥林匹克公园.
steps.past: Saw the Bird's Nest at 奥林匹克公园 with 兔儿爷.

title: Shared bikes
blurb: Shared bikes stand on every corner; the courier says they are the fastest way round.
lead: The courier in 三里屯 zips past on a bike.

steps.now: The courier says: scan a shared bike 共享单车 at a stand and ride. Try one — park at any stand.
steps.past: Rode a shared bike for the first time.
